availability.evidence: Availability is a declared monotone synthetic formula; no device clock or measured service time exists.

cross_hop_behavior.evidence: Four caller chunk plans reproduce identical event digests; no scheduler or device hop was measured.

dropped_stale_events.evidence: A bounded synthetic event bus records stale-epoch, stale-sequence and queue-full drops explicitly.

event_boundaries_scored.evidence: Detected speech runs are compared with fixture-construction active segments; no candidate boundary output exists.

exact_source_intervals.evidence: Every event uses exact half-open sample intervals; the final partial frame advances by its valid count only.

idle_noise.evidence: Deterministic low-amplitude integer LCG noise covers lead, mid and tail idle regions.

independent_state.evidence: Two interleaved sessions produce the same digests as independent solo runs.

known_positives_and_negatives.evidence: Frame labels are exact fixture-construction positives and negatives; there are no real recordings.

onset_offset_delay.evidence: Onset and offset frame delays are measured against the synthetic segment boundaries only.

quiet_and_active_speech.evidence: The fixture declares active and quiet segments; labels come from construction, not from a CRNN.

stratified_fn_fp.evidence: FN/FP rates are stratified over active-speech and quiet-noise synthetic frames; no held-out cohort exists.

timestamped_probabilities_scored.evidence: Per-frame timestamped probability_micro records are scored with an integer Brier metric on the synthetic fixture only.

validity_separate_from_nonspeech.evidence: Invalid and missing frames carry null probability, are excluded from denominators and are never scored as nonspeech.

board_row.note: Only stable linked-row fields are read and gated. The mutable full plan/swarm/TASKS.json is never hashed, pinned or used as a digest source.

candidate.finding: No exact CRNN architecture/checkpoint/source or adapter is selected; accuracy and performance cannot be measured for an undefined candidate.
